channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
item.description: Brick By Brick is a relaxing tidy-up game you can play solo or co-op with up to 5 players. Collect, sort, and place 18,490 bricks to rebuild a charming town. Unlock helpful abilities and watch scattered piles become finished buildings. One brick at a time!

item.title: Cake Bash
item.description: Fight to be the tastiest cake in Cake Bash! A frantic four player party game where adorable drawn-to-life cakes beat the crumbs out of each other.

item.title: Dupery: A Game of Solo Deduction
item.description: A solo deduction roguelite with over 175 roles, set in a noir city run by a criminal syndicate. Investigate everyone, make arrests and protect your reputation. Take down the syndicate and don’t get duped like the rest. Everyone is a suspect, trust no one. No friends required.

item.title: EarthX 2
item.description: Build and run your own space company. Launch reusable rockets, complete missions, and run a satellite internet network. Manage your factories and fleet, supply colonies on the Moon and Mars, and work toward terraforming the Red Planet.

item.title: Keyboard Chaos
item.description: 2,692 keycaps. 32 keyboards. One messy desk. Find the right keycaps, match them to their positions, and complete every keyboard, square or round. Search, organize, and enjoy the satisfying process of turning chaos into perfectly assembled keyboards.

item.title: One Million Coins
item.description: A short, focused first-person incremental mining game. Dig through a vault of one million coins, bank your haul, buy better tools, and build an ever-faster gold-collecting operation.

item.title: War Footing
item.description: War Footing puts you in command of a nation's defenses. With limited time & resources, and tension rising, can you build the military needed to save your country's independence?

item.title: DayZ Badlands
item.description: DayZ Badlands throws you into the troubled territories of Nasdara Province—267km² of arid expanse. Uncover its secrets, battle for control, forge fragile alliances and rebuild from the ashes of past wars. Survival here isn't just measured in drops of water saved, but in bullets spared.

item.title: Realm of Taiwu
item.description: Realm of Taiwu is a The Scroll of Taiwu spin-off. The story unfolds across an alternate branching timeline of the original universe: the Taiwu Hero never arrives, the Fuyu Sword falls to Xiangshu, and the world sinks into endless darkness.

item.title: Absolute Drift
item.description: Absolute Drift is a racing game about becoming a master at the art of drifting.

item.title: Valve Index® Base Station
item.description: Room-scale precision, with lasers.The highest-quality tracking has gotten even better with Base Station 2.0, featuring improved range, wider field of view, and support for up to four Base Stations in a single setup, creating a larger play area while reducing occlusion.Compatible with Valve Index or HTC Vive Pro.

item.title: Cozy Builder
item.description: Build, design, and decorate your dream château in a cozy vineyard valley. Live among your creations, harvest grapes from sunlit vineyards, and craft artisanal wine blends in a relaxing sandbox builder where every home helps restore beauty and balance to the countryside.

item.title: Dumb Ways to Build
item.description: Dumb Ways to Build is a chaotic, physics-based co-op game. Team up with friends to assemble your crew and take-on dangerous construction jobs. With all the gear and no idea, work together to build your path forward, or die trying!

item.title: Golden Lap
item.description: Step into the polished shoes of a racing team manager in the heart-stirring Golden Era of motorsport where every decision can lead to glory or gravel. With sleek minimalist charm and deep strategic gameplay, Golden Lap offers a unique experience in the motorsport management genre.

item.title: Gunner, HEAT, PC!
item.description: Gunner, HEAT, PC! (GHPC) is a simulation game about modern mounted combat, with special attention to authenticity and fun.

item.title: STAGE TOUR
item.description: Build your band, hit the stage, and go on tour in Stage Tour, the next evolution of music rhythm games. Rock over 90 officially licensed tracks, unlock over 180 authentic Gibson®, Epiphone® and Kramer® guitars, and experience five game modes, including the all-new roguelite Tour Mode.

item.title: Voidtrain - Big Catch
item.description: Catch fish aboard your train, upgrade your gear, and earn Scales with every catch to spend on fishing upgrades and train decor.

item.title: Gear.Club Unlimited 3 - Gear.Club Signature Pack
item.description: Get the Gear.Club Signature Pack and enjoy two exclusive liveries: the Honda S2000 GCU3 Edition and the BMW Z4 GCU Edition. Taking inspiration from Japanese culture, they will transform your cars into works of art!

item.title: Rotwood: Drakin Armoury Pack
item.description: A new weapon and playable species have landed in Rotwood! Join the Drakin and use their fabled Greatsword to conquer the woods and fight back against the vicious Drakinspawn.

item.title: MXGP 26 - Scrubdesignz Liveries
item.description: This DLC gives you access to 6 SCRUB Designz liveries for your bike.
